s.id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, s.spec_ids, s.spec_text, s.sku_image, s.sku_images, s.detail_images, s.product_price, s.sales_count, s.weight, s.safety_stock, s.max_stock, s.stock_warn_enable, s.gain_points, s.exchange_points, s.sale_enable, s.sort, s.create_by, s.update_by, s.create_time, s.update_time, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.main_image, p.status AS product_status,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.stock - i.locked_stock), 0) FROM shop_erp_inventory i WHERE i.sku_id = s.id AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_erp_warehouse w WHERE w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1)) AS available_stock,
(SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.cost_price * i.stock) / NULLIF(SUM(i.stock), 0), 2) FROM shop_erp_inventory i WHERE i.sku_id = s.id AND i.is_deleted = 0) AS cost_price, c.category_name, b.brand_name, st.store_name

FROM shop_product_sku s JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_store st ON st.id = p.store_id AND st.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.spec_text, s.sku_image, s.sku_images, s.detail_images, s.product_price, s.gain_points, s.sale_enable, s.sales_count,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.stock - i.locked_stock), 0) FROM shop_erp_inventory i WHERE i.sku_id = s.id AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_erp_warehouse w WHERE w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1)) AS available_stock FROM shop_product_sku s WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY s.sort ASC, s.id ASC
